title: E0106: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
plain_english: Deserializing untrusted data using `unserialize()` or `wddx_deserialize()` can instantiate arbitrary PHP objects and trigger magic methods, leading to object injection.
why_matters: Deserialization of untrusted data is a critical vulnerability. Attackers can: - Instantiate arbitrary PHP classes - Trigger magic methods (`__wakeup()`, `__destruct()`) - Execute arbitrary code through gadget chains - Achieve remote code execution
what_it_checks: `unserialize()` calls with tainted input from superglobals
